Opens access to a large NASA procurement pool, but selection is not a task order or guaranteed revenue.
Option extends program to 2041; ceiling rises to $15B
The larger ceiling and extended timeline are conditional on an option; no task-order value is disclosed.
Four lunar mission contracts awarded under CLPS 1
